text:
Iris: Escalating OnboardPay trial - onboarding stuck at webhook verification. Support ticket CSUP-67890. Customer sees intermittent 502s during bulk seat import and says this jeopardizes demo and renewal.

Ben: Can you paste a sample error and region?

Iris: From support: ```502: provisioning_error - step=webhook-verify - tx=9f8e7d - at=2026-03-24T11:22:08Z``` Happening in eu-west-1 after a 1k-seat import attempt.

Lina: Looks like our webhook worker pool is saturating; retry storms from the client are compounding it. We should throttle retries and move the job to a background queue.

Carlos: I can temporarily increase worker concurrency for account=onboardpay-55 and add a priority queue. Need approval to touch prod config.

Nora: I'll handle customer comms and schedule an enablement call. Preferred window: tomorrow 09:00 CET.

Iris: Plan (owners):
- Carlos: apply temp concurrency bump + priority queue (now)
- Lina: hotfix client guidance + patch for exponential backoff (ETA 2h)
- Nora: send interim comms + run enablement call (tomorrow 09:00 CET)
- Ben: monitor metrics and rollback if errors increase

Carlos: Applied temp change: worker_pool=webhook-workers, concurrency=+50% for onboardpay-55, priority=high, revert window=48h. Monitoring.

Lina: Drafted client guidance and short patch: add randomized backoff and max-retries=5. Pushed link: https://github.com/redwood/onboardpay-client/commit/patch789

Nora: Interim message sent: "We've prioritized and queued your import and applied temporary capacity to reduce failures. We'll walk through best practices on the enablement call tomorrow." Customer replied: "Thanks, please confirm when imports complete - this demo is critical."

Ben: Metrics show error rate dropping. We'll keep renewal_watch flag for 30 days and schedule a follow-up 1:1 a week after the demo to capture feedback.

Iris: Adding CS action items: add renewal_watch, capture post-call notes, propose 1-month free import support if SLA breach >24h (tag finance).

Nora: I'll run the call and capture feedback; will update this thread with action items and customer sentiment afterwards. :thumbsup:
